title: Microsoft Plans Data Center Push to Triple Its Computing Power
description:
Microsoft Corp. plans to more than triple its data center capacity to help overcome a computing shortage that has forced it to turn away some AI and cloud business. Bloomberg's Anurag Rana joins to discuss.
